title: OpenAI links Russian and Iranian campaigns to real media placements
teaser: OpenAI disclosed two influence operations tied to Russia and Iran that used fabricated material to place propaganda in real media outlets. The Russian-linked campaign drew a response from politicians in Ecuador and Peru, making it the company’s most consequential case of this kind in two and a half years of reporting. The Iranian operation placed nearly 100 articles through fake journalists, but its social-media comments attracted little attention.
